mapper.insert: INSERT INTO check_in_exception ( student_id, check_in_id, exception_type, status, handler_id, handler_note, handled_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{checkInId}, #{exceptionType}, #{status}, #{handlerId}, #{handlerNote}, #{handledAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id AS studentId, check_in_id AS checkInId, exception_type AS exceptionType, status, handler_id AS handlerId, handler_note AS handlerNote, handled_at AS handledAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM check_in_exception WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE check_in_exception SET status = #{status}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handler_note = #{handlerNote}, handled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id AS studentId, check_in_id AS checkInId, exception_type AS exceptionType, status, handler_id AS handlerId, handler_note AS handlerNote, handled_at AS handledAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM check_in_exception WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC
